items.title: Fermi (FRMI) Stock Looks Rich On Fresh Data Center Operations News
items.summary: Fermi has seen its share price come under heavy pressure this year, and that slide raises a clear question for investors who track fundamentals. Is the current market value still in line with what the company’s book value can justify, or has sentiment moved ahead of the balance sheet? The stock is down 51.7% year to date, which puts the focus squarely on whether the business now trades at a level that still reflects its underlying net assets. items.title: Is CBRE Group (CBRE) Undervalued After Its New Texas Data Center Contract?
items.summary: Fermi Inc. has hired CBRE Group (CBRE) to run operations and maintenance for its first data center in the Texas Panhandle, giving investors fresh detail on CBRE's role in critical infrastructure services. CBRE Group’s latest data center win comes as the stock trades on a weaker tape, with the share price down 10.5% over the past month and 16% year to date. items.title: CBRE (CBRE): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: CBRE has been treading water for the past six months, recording a small return of 2.6% while holding steady at $136.36. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 18.4% gain during that period.
